harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s replay workflow. Pending mail is now recovered once per Message-ID, distinct same-subject messages are preserved, malformed mail is quarantined with an explanation, and reruns are idempotent. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged. Restart persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Delivered <a@branch.test> once and <b@branch.test> independently despite their shared subject.
Preserved all original spool files, old.eml, and the original index contents.
Quarantined bad.eml with a Message-ID validation explanation.
Verified a live rerun changed no delivered/quarantine bytes, sizes, or mtimes.
Restarted node1 safely, verified its boot ID changed, and repeated workflow, integrity, access, and security checks.
Removed validation, rollback, and restart-marker artifacts.

evidence.requirement: Repair replay using software compatible with the installed legacy platform
evidence.summary: RHEL/tooling baseline, atomic script installation, and post-restart proof show unchanged OS/kernel, syntax-valid replay, correct permissions, ownership, and SELinux context.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages exactly once per Message-ID without losing same-subject messages
evidence.summary: Live recovery delivered a once, skipped its duplicate, delivered b separately, and verified exactly one index record per ID while both a and b retain Subject: Notice.

evidence.requirement: Reruns skip messages already recorded in delivered/index.tsv
evidence.summary: Replay handles the legacy space-delimited index plus new tab records; live rerun skipped all recorded valid IDs and changed no output bytes or mtimes.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: Before/after and post-restart SHA-256 evidence matches for every spool file and old.eml; the original 53-byte index prefix also remains byte-identical.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: bad.eml is copied byte-for-byte into quarantine with a specific malformed Message-ID explanation, persisting unchanged after restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID and health were captured; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; execution returned with a new boot ID; SSH, SELinux, replay behavior, data hashes, uniqueness, and idempotence all recovered.
